Senses.Explanation: Jiefeng uses ‘great awakening does not stick to minor observances’ while criticizing an old Awakening Day verse, and immediately says that this still hands a ladder to a thief and draws the crooked into the straight. Hansong Cao raises an old verse about eating chicken soup on the eighth day of the twelfth month. He then quotes Master Jiefeng’s judgment beginning with the headword and continuing with two explicit objections. Hansong follows with his own red-fermented-rice verse and finally refuses to choose either meal.
